application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding binary-product round was authoritatively rechecked and its 1356-source manifest was copied before new proof edits. Retained proof sources and exact selected axiom sets remain fixed.

The original finite product group, tangent model and chart model are constructed recursively. The n=0 case is one original factor, rather than an empty product; adding the zero input makes the actual selected evaluation family nonempty. All recursively constructed structures are locally installed definitions or proved propositions. No supplied finite-product Lie group or simply-connectedness premise is introduced.

The chart model uses the actual ModelProd tags at every recursive step. It is not assigned a guessed chart structure on a plain function type. The actual product chart, model with corners, Lie group and boundaryless structures are checked together; contractibility of the original factors proves product simply connectedness.

The finite Lie evaluation map is recursively composed through the proved native binary product Lie equivalence. Each coordinate equals the corresponding original Lie evaluation, and actual joint injectivity transfers to the native homomorphism. No point separation or bracket comparison is assumed for the array algebra.

The exact original exponential formulas use the retained actual binary-product exponential theorem. The global logarithm coordinate formula uses original exponential injectivity and the actual global inverse identities. Neither BCH functoriality nor a replacement exponential is introduced.

The finite evaluation selection is the retained proven fixed set. Augmentation by the zero integer input and a genuine finite equivalence enumerate it, even when the original set is empty. Every original selected evaluation is recovered through this equivalence, so the retained full coefficient separation proves injectivity for all coefficient vectors simultaneously.

The finite image is an actual Lie subalgebra range in the actual finite-product native Lie algebra. The retained Picard logarithm subgroup proof integrates it. Actual range membership supplies coefficient preimages; native exponential injectivity and coefficient embedding injectivity prove their uniqueness. The same actual subgroup is closed, contractible and simply connected.

This does not yet identify the finite image subgroup with all-integer arrays under pointwise multiplication. Compatibility with unselected integer evaluations still requires an argument, as do the specified lattice discreteness, cocompactness and smooth quotient maps. The main StrongConjecture, inverse input and recurrence input remain unproved.

Seven new modules contain 26 theorems and 13 definitions, all 39 declarations selected for kernel audit. No proof holes, new axioms, structures, global instances, unsafe code or resource settings are introduced. Strict focused checks, full build, kernel checks, retained-source and exact-axiom comparisons and final recheck must terminate successfully.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. Compatibility of reconstructed multiplication with every remaining integer evaluation, construction and identification of the full native array group, its specified discrete cocompact lattice and smooth quotient evaluation remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the actual native polynomial-array model action with its required nilpotence and translation compatibility, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
